basic_profile.bio: Avid birdwatcher and motorcycle enthusiast from the Pacific Northwest. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to travel and explore various birding hotspots. I enjoy sharing my birdwatching experiences and learning about different species from around the world. In my free time, I ride my Moto Guzzi along scenic routes and indulge in folklore studies. Typically online during the late evenings, I appreciate engaging discussions and sharing knowledge. Currently in a long-term relationship with someone who shares my passion for nature and adventure.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Deeply knowledgeable in ornithology, particularly North American bird species, acquired through self-study and extensive birdwatching trips. Additionally, possess a solid understanding of motorcycles, particularly the Moto Guzzi brand, gained through years of riding and mechanical tinkering. Folklore interest is more of a casual endeavor but backed by readings and participation in related online communities.
